dimensions.name: Relationship recovery under a prescribed specification
Relationship discovery from data alone
dimensions.justification: Feature importances only, no false-discovery control. Planted tasks: TPR 1.0, FDR 0.310, silent on 1/5 null tasks.

dimensions.name: Experimental iteration speed
dimensions.justification: Session median 0.76 s, p90 1.2 s per follow-up (sub-second median).

dimensions.name: Robustness across conditions
dimensions.justification: Completes 285/285 real runs; small-n median 7.0% above the reference. Large-n unmeasured.

dimensions.name: Uncertainty honesty (calibration)
dimensions.justification: Two quantile models: median coverage 0.790, 92.1% of runs below 0.85; S3 terciles 0.811/0.763/0.738. Binary median ECE 0.037.

dimensions.name: Reproducibility and auditability
dimensions.justification: Identical on rerun 10/10; no decision trail.

dimensions.name: Predictive validity
dimensions.justification: Beats the reference on 36/45 regression and 27/50 binary tasks; median gap to best 9.5% (regression) and 29.4% (binary); within 5% of best on 15/45 and 6/50.
